description: Return the source of specific functions without the surrounding file. Pin exact node paths with `nodes`, or describe what you want in `intent` to let concept search choose. Measured 97.85% fewer bytes than reading the whole file across ten nodes, and cheaper on all ten (docs/context-vs-read-cost.md). Prefer this over opening a file to read one function. Use `find_definition` or `search_code` first if you do not know the node path.

include_tests.description: Also return the source of tests that cover each node. Off by default: it costs substantially more bytes.

intent.description: Natural-language description of the code you want, used only when `nodes` is omitted.

nodes.description: Exact node paths, e.g. crate::crates::aether-graph::src::lib::SemanticGraph::tests_for. Use find_definition or search_code to discover them.

name: get_source
title: Get a function's source
